goal: Fix api.db_data_admin_scraped_source_inventory so its Character and Style Guide arms read plm.wb_character_normalized and plm.wb_style_guide_normalized instead of the dropped plm.wb_character and plm.wb_style_guide, with a contract test that executes every arm.
prohibited_actions: No change to any object other than api.db_data_admin_scraped_source_inventory.
No grant widening beyond the original function's grants.
No direct DDL on production outside the governed migration route.
No licensed row contents in public artifacts.
assumptions: plm.wb_character_normalized and plm.wb_style_guide_normalized exist on production with source_namespace, source_id, fallback_key, label, status, last_seen_at and capture_id columns.
stop_conditions: Stop if the normalized relations lack a column the arms need.
Stop if the PR must edit the protected coordination source.
